LESSON: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do Muslims perform prayers on special occasions?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA
Study Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way

What this means
In this part you learn to perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara in your own words. (skill: perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings.
3. Practise this skill: perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do Muslims perform prayers on special occasions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings.
5. Be able to: perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
